answer: Count only endorsements from strangers. Each identity must earn backing from witnesses who share no contacts with each other — a nebula of disconnected observers, not a circle of friends. A sybil farm is a dune of identical grains: its puppets all endorse one another, forming one tight clique. Under an onyx-hard rule, clique-internal endorsements discount to nearly nothing, so weight comes only from outsiders the farm cannot manufacture. Spawning more puppets adds no new strangers, and therefore no new influence.
